Source precedence: the 2014-2019 SFU-SFUFA Collective Agreement (in force on 2018-02-24) governs. Policy A 31.05 (rev. 2006; still on the policy site in March 2018) predates it and differs (fathers 18 paid weeks; combined maximum 50 weeks); the CA101 handout says the new agreement makes 'Parental leave available to men and women on the same basis' and that the agreement prevails. The A 31.05 differences are flagged conflicting_sources on c1-c3, not coded as separate components.
Path coded: a continuing (tenure-track) Member, long term, eligible for EI and for LTD (U8). Short-term and recurring limited term Members: unpaid ESA leave only (c25).

Chain, birth parent: SFU Leave for New Parents 35 weeks (paid by c2 within it: 2 weeks at 95% salary, then 33 weeks topped up to 95%) → CA unpaid leave (c3) to a combined 52 weeks. Statutory leave alongside from week 0: ESA pregnancy 17 (c4, concurrent with c1) → recovery extension 6 (c5) → ESA parental 35 (c6) → child's condition 5 (c7). EI maternity 15 from week 1 (c8, offset 1) → EI parental 35 (c9).

Chain, non-birth parent: SFU Leave for New Parents 35 weeks (c2 within it) → CA unpaid leave (c3) to a combined 52 weeks; ESA parental 37 (c6) concurrent with c1 from week 0 → child's condition 5 (c7); EI parental 35 from week 1 (c9, offset 1).

EI waiting period: the CA (47.16) pays 'two weeks at 95% salary (Employment Insurance waiting period)', written for the pre-2017 two-week wait; coded as written (R21). The FR page (captured 2018-05) says that from 2017-01-01 the wait is one week and the university pays that first week at 95% when the member must serve it. EI starts one week after the leave (programs.csv).

Not components: study leave (Art. 46; scholarly purpose, not usable for a birth), though 46.12 counts maternity or parental leave toward study-leave service; research leave for Chairs (51.33); paid non-disciplinary leave pending medical information (44.20); leave with/without pay during criminal proceedings (22.4-22.5); phased retirement (49.7-49.21, age 60+); the TPC/Promotions Committee ineligibility of members on parental leave (29.9, 36.82); 47.3 (a leave of absence does not normally alter the tenure timetable).
Calendar: 27.3 states three teaching semesters of four months each; term_weeks 17.33 (no component is coded in semesters).

Documents cited but not saved: BC Family Law Act; Policy A 31.03 (benefits during sick leave); the LTD Plan master agreement; FR sub-page 'Changes to Parental Leave Benefits' and the 'Parental Leave Application Form May 2/18'; and many policies named only for non-leave topics (I 10.05, I 10.04, GP 17, GP 18, GP 19, R 60.01, R 30.03, R 10.01, R 10.03, GP 37, I 10.10, A 10.01, A 12.10, A 13.02, A 13.04, A 11.10, A 20.01).
